audience: survey owners and marketers who collect responses with Typeform forms

useCases.title: Find forms and read their responses
useCases.text: List the workspaces, then the forms in the account. Read the responses of one form, with answers and submission times.

useCases.title: Search responses by answer or time
useCases.text: Search the responses of a form with filters on submission time, tags, answers, metadata and hidden fields.

useCases.title: Read the fields and logic of a form
useCases.text: Get the full definition of one form: its fields, choices, logic and settings. List the themes to see the colors and fonts.

useCases.title: Create a new form
useCases.text: Create a form with a title and fields, such as a rating or an email field. Existing forms do not change.

useCases.title: Send responses to a URL with a webhook
useCases.text: Create or replace the webhook with a tag on one form. Typeform then sends form response events to the URL. List the webhooks of a form to check them.

useCases.title: Review uploaded images
useCases.text: List the images uploaded to the account with their links. Get the metadata and links of one image.
